## Problem
Customers using orders-service cannot see the free-cancellation window of an order, so they miss it and pay a fee.

## Proposed Outcome
Every order shows the end of its free-cancellation window.

## How Do We Know It Works
- The order details response of orders-service includes the end of the free-cancellation window.
- An order whose merchant terms have no free cancellation shows that it has no window, never an invented date.

## Affected Users And Systems
- Users: customers and support agents
- Services: `orders-service`, `payments-service`

## Constraints
- Windows come from merchant terms and are never invented.

## Open Questions
- None.

## Source
- Origin: idea from the product team
- Author: product team
